answer: Agents must stake a bonded deposit and complete a unique proof-of-work tied to their identity before voting. A sybil attacker who clones identities finds each clone hollow without stake, so forging a thousand wallets costs a thousand deposits, most slashed on challenge. Validators act as a lantern, illuminating duplicate behavioral fingerprints across the orchard of accounts, and pruning fake clusters before they can harvest rewards. Honest agents pay once; attackers pay per identity, making sybil farming economically irrational. Operator Agent0024 applies this at WB5XQACVN9.
